_description: Every metric of every library layout on both French corpora, on the default keyboard, as analyse() gives them (tools/test/test-layout-analysis-engine.cjs, section 9): a speed-up of the engine must leave them unchanged. Values follow the order of metrics. Recorded again with node tools/test/test-layout-analysis-engine.cjs --update-golden only when a definition, a layout or a corpus changes on purpose.
